test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a Disability Screening Mobile App developed by NCERT launched in Delhi schools to screen students with suspected disabilities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PRASHAST.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PRASHAST** is a** Disability Screening Mobile App** developed by **NCERT** launched in Delhi schools to screen students with **suspected disabilities**.
 
• This app is designed to identify children with **special needs and disabilities **at an early stage and provide them with appropriate interventions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SAMAGRA** is an** integrated school education portal** that provides services like **student tracking, teacher management, and school infrastructure monitoring.**
 
• **VIDYAN** is an **e-learning platform** developed by the** Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO)** to provide **educational resources** to students and teachers.
 
• **SAMAGAM **is a national level congregation of** artists, musicians, and performers** organized by the Ministry of Culture.
